# smart-trust-phw-catalogue

Qualified Dublin Core (`folio-dublin-core/v1`) and materialization fixity (`folio-catalogue-node/v1`) records for the upstream IHE ITI specifications materialized in `library/`: IHE ITI PCF 1.1.0 and IHE ITI VHL 1.0.0-comment. `bun run cat check:catalogue` and `bun run cat check:materialized-fixity` verify every node, metadataRef, libraryId, localPath, and SHA-256 digest. Bean sl5v.

Part of [GDHCN Trust Network - Personal Health Wallet](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `smart-trust-phw-catalogue`, holding `catalogue`.
